verdict.rationale: Claude's built-in Cowork feature explicitly lets users delegate multi-step tasks ('describe an outcome, step away, come back to finished work'), with agentic execution including browser/computer use, scheduling, and research that autonomously plans next steps. This is well-documented first-party functionality directly matching task delegation to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of Cowork's delegation reliability (community evidence covers Claude Code/coding use more than Cowork specifically).
